title: TP53 mutation is enriched in colorectal cancer liver metastasis in the context of polyclonal seeding.
authors: Sun, Wenjie; Sun, Qingrong; Zhong, Anjing; Lyne, Anne-Marie; Huang, Dongdong; Han, Fengyan; Lai, Maode; Zhang, Honghe
one_liner_zh: 该文通过测序分析TP53突变在结直肠癌肝转移中的富集，属于纯基因组测序与临床转移研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cancer metastasis accounts for the majority of cancer motility burden. For colorectal cancer (CRC), the liver is the most common site of distant metastasis. It is still little known that cancer genomic mutations, which are a cell-intrinsic and heritable property, are enriched in CRC liver metastasis. Here, we try to answer the question in the context of polyclonal seeding. In this study, we sequenced 18 pairs of colorectal cancer primary tumors and their matched liver metastasis samples. Together with public available sequencing data, we compared the mutations in 113 primary and metastasis pairs. The TP53 mutation variant allele frequency (VAF) was significantly increased in metastasis compared to the paired primary tumor, although most of the frequently observed mutations in liver metastasis foci were concordant with their matched CRC primary tumors. The results support late metastasis and polyclonal seeding. Consequently, we quantitatively compared the intratumor heterogeneity (ITH) between primary and metastasis tumors, and with the help of in silico metastasis simulation, we inferred that more than 10 cells take part in the CRC liver metastasis.
abstract_zh: 癌症转移占癌症运动负担的大部分。对于结直肠癌（CRC），肝脏是远处转移最常见的部位。目前尚不清楚的是，作为细胞内在且可遗传特性的癌症基因组突变，在CRC肝转移中是否富集。在此，我们尝试在多克隆播种的背景下回答这一问题。在本研究中，我们对18对结直肠癌原发肿瘤及其匹配的肝转移样本进行了测序。结合公开可用的测序数据，我们比较了113对原发与转移样本中的突变。TP53突变等位基因频率（VAF）在转移中显著高于配对的原发肿瘤，尽管肝转移灶中观察到的大多数频繁突变与其匹配的CRC原发肿瘤一致。结果支持晚期转移和多克隆播种。因此，我们定量比较了原发与转移肿瘤之间的瘤内异质性（ITH），并借助计算机模拟转移，推断出超过10个细胞参与了CRC肝转移。
